collectors.titleDetails: (3 total Queries, 3 of them unique across 1 Connection)

queries.sql: SELECT c.id as client_id, c.full_name, c.phone, c.email, c.status as client_status, u.full_name as asesor_name, z.name as zone_name, cri.id as interest_id, cri.status as interest_status, cri.apartado_date, re.name as property_name, re.clave as property_clave, re.status as property_status, ca.status as account_status, cr_cancel.name as cancellation_reason, COALESCE(cri.cancellation_notes, c.deactivation_notes) as cancellation_notes, COALESCE(cri.cancelled_at, c.deactivated_at) as cancelled_at, CASE WHEN cri.status = 'Vendido' OR (re.status = 'Vendido' AND re.sold_to_client_id = c.id) THEN 'compro' WHEN cri.status = 'Cancelado' OR c.status IN ('Descartado', 'Cancelado') THEN 'cancelado' WHEN cri.status = 'Apartado' AND ca.status = 'Activa' THEN 'en_tramite' WHEN cri.status = 'Apartado' THEN 'apartado' ELSE 'interesado' END AS pipeline_stage FROM `clients` `c` LEFT JOIN `users` `u` ON `u`.`id` = `c`.`user_id` LEFT JOIN `zones` `z` ON `z`.`id` = `c`.`zone_id` LEFT JOIN client_real_estate_interests cri ON cri.id = ( SELECT cri2.id FROM client_real_estate_interests cri2 WHERE cri2.client_id = c.id ORDER BY FIELD(cri2.status, 'Vendido', 'Apartado', 'Cancelado', 'Interesado'), cri2.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN `real_estates` `re` ON `re`.`id` = `cri`.`real_estate_id` LEFT JOIN `client_accounts` `ca` ON `ca`.`real_estate_interest_id` = `cri`.`id` AND `ca`.`client_id` = `c`.`id` LEFT JOIN cancellation_reasons cr_cancel ON cr_cancel.id = COALESCE(cri.cancellation_reason_id, c.deactivation_reason_id) WHERE `c`.`status` IN ('Cliente','Descartado','Cancelado','Seguimiento','Cierre') AND (`c`.`client_type` = 'comprador' OR `c`.`client_type` IS NULL OR `c`.`client_type` = '') AND `c`.`user_id` = '2' ORDER BY `c`.`full_name` ASC
